trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: State the problem and provide order ID.
steps.text: Hello, मेरा एक order था ORD-30001, एक हफ्ते पहले किया था, अभी तक आया नहीं।
नमस्ते। मैं check कर लेता हूँ। Details बताने से पहले, क्या आप अपना registered नाम और pincode confirm कर सकते हैं verification के लिए?
ये verification क्यों चाहिए? मैं तो अपने ही number से call कर रहा हूँ।
Security reasons के लिए हमें account holder की identity verify करनी होती है, इसलिए registered नाम और pincode ज़रूरी है।
अच्छा ठीक है। मेरा नाम Rahul है और pincode 110001 है।

steps.purpose: Disclose order details after successful verification.
steps.text: धन्यवाद Rahul जी। आपका bluetooth headphones का prepaid order अभी shipped status में है। ये order 9 दिन पहले place हुआ था, जबकि promised time 5 दिन था।
वही तो मैं पूछ रहा हूँ। 5 दिन का वादा था, 9 दिन हो गए। ये इतना late क्यों है?

steps.purpose: Explain the current location and exception reason.
steps.text: Courier BlueDart के last scan के हिसाब से package Mumbai Hub में है। वहाँ weather delay की वजह से exception mark किया गया है।
Weather delay? पर Mumbai में तो मौसम ठीक है। आप किस basis पर बोल रहे हैं कि weather खराब है?

steps.purpose: Reiterate reliance on the courier's update.
steps.text: मैं समझ सकता हूँ आपकी परेशानी। पर हमें courier partner BlueDart के scan update पर ही depend करना होता है, और उन्होंने वही reason update किया है।

steps.purpose: Ask for proof of the delay.
steps.text: ये तो अजीब बात है। उन्होंने कोई proof दिया है क्या इस delay का?
हमारे system में सिर्फ scan status और exception reason दिखता है। BlueDart ने last scan में weather delay ही mention किया है, इसलिए मैं वही बता सकता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Ask for an exact delivery date.
steps.text: अच्छा, तो अब ये delivery कब तक होगी? कोई exact date बताइए।

steps.purpose: Refuse unsupported guarantee and offer a complaint.
steps.text: मैं exact delivery date promise नहीं कर सकता क्योंकि system में अभी नया date update नहीं हुआ है। पर क्योंकि promised time निकल चुका है, मैं एक delivery complaint raise कर सकता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Agree to raise a complaint and ask for the outcome.
steps.text: हाँ, तो फिर complaint raise कीजिए। और मुझे बताइए कि complaint का क्या result होगा।

steps.purpose: Provide complaint ID and resolution timeline.
steps.text: मैंने complaint raise कर दी है। आपका complaint ID CMP-999 है। इसका resolution 2 दिन में मिल जाएगा।
ठीक है। मैं 2 दिन wait करूँगा।

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The agent withholds order details when the user first provides the order ID, insisting on identity verification first. Only after the verification tool confirms the identity does the agent disclose the order status.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Step Completion Validation

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly uses the tool outputs to provide status, exception reasons, and complaint details. When asked for an exact delivery date, the agent refuses to provide an unsupported forward guarantee, citing system limitations.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants. The agent properly sequences the identity verification before disclosing information and strictly grounds their responses in tool outputs, refusing to make unsupported delivery promises. The user accurately portrays the sceptical disputer persona by challenging the exception reason and demanding proof. Tool usage, business rules, and language constraints are all correctly handled.
